info.title: Elastic Maintainer API
info.description: Initial web-first API contract. Endpoints marked with 501 responses are registered skeletons whose domain execution lands in later phases. Documented GET read operations also accept HEAD with identical status and headers and no response body, except the bounded server-sent job event stream.

302.description: Redirect to the configured OIDC authorization endpoint

303.description: OIDC login completed; application session established

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Repeatable exact job type filter; at most 16 values and no duplicates.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Repeatable exact job status filter; at most 16 values and no duplicates.

200.description: Live inventory job and paginated result

bearerAuth.description: OIDC JWT access token, bounded to 16 KiB and validated with RS256 or ES256 against the configured pinned issuer, client audience, JWKS transport, and claim-to-role mapping. Bearer tokens do not require a browser nonce. Duplicate Authorization headers or any simultaneous application-session cookie are rejected.

EventStreamAccept.name: Accept
EventStreamAccept.description: One Accept header containing text/event-stream, optionally followed by one q parameter: q=1, q=1.0, q=1.00, q=1.000, or a positive q=0.xxx with one to three decimal digits. Lists and other parameters are rejected.

CSRFToken.name: X-CSRF-Token
CSRFToken.description: Required for browser cookie mutations including logout, validation, live inventory, credential changes, and job cancellation; omit for bearer automation where supported.

NotImplemented.description: Endpoint contract is registered but domain execution is not implemented

JobEventLimit.description: Too many concurrent job event streams

csrfToken.description: Ephemeral browser CSRF token; do not persist.

JobEventStream.description: UTF-8 SSE framing with event: job, one compact data line, and a SHA-256 event ID. The data is the redacted JobResponse projection and is limited to 4096 serialized bytes per event.
